description: Open-set categorical market with a catch-all outcome.

spec.question: Which artist will have the #1 song on the Billboard Hot 100 chart dated 2027-01-02?
spec.shortDescription: Tracks the first Billboard Hot 100 number one of 2027.

outcomes.name: Taylor Swift
outcomes.winCondition: Taylor Swift is the lead artist of the #1 song.

outcomes.name: Drake
outcomes.winCondition: Drake is the lead artist of the #1 song.

outcomes.name: Sabrina Carpenter
outcomes.winCondition: Sabrina Carpenter is the lead artist of the #1 song.

outcomes.name: Other / None
outcomes.winCondition: Any other lead artist has the #1 song, or no chart is published.

sources.extraction: Lead artist of the song at position 1

edgeCases.scenario: Billboard does not publish the 2027-01-02 chart by 2026-12-31T23:59:59Z
A listed artist appears only as a featured artist on the #1 song
